# Three Philosophies for Structuring AI Coding Agent Skills

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfTRO1qHAQy/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** George Wang · **Saved:** 2026-11-04

## Summary

This video compares three approaches to structuring AI coding agent plugins and skills: process-driven (Addy Osmani), codebase constraint-driven (Lauren Tan), and product-driven (Matt Pocock). It advocates applying 'The Bitter Lesson' to agent instructions by constraining outcomes and testing rules for ablation rather than micromanaging model behavior.
